text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One gave a powerful performance in 
her debut race. Watching from the stands, 
Super Creek and Oguri Cap praised her 
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The person in question, still riding high 
on the thrill of the race, overflowed with 
vigor and motivation for her next 
challenge.
